name: billed_call_is_not_repeated_after_a_read_timeout
description: Pins the retry table's `billed` class (every billed read now takes an Idempotency-Key and is `keyed`, so no route is in it). A billed call is charged once it has done the work, so a request that timed out after it was sent may already be charged. Without a key, a repeat that returns different rows is charged for them, so it is raised rather than repeated.
